products.title: CalDigit TS4 Thunderbolt 4 Dock
products.summary: 18-port Thunderbolt 4 workstation dock with 98 W host charging and 2.5 GbE.

specs.host_connection: Thunderbolt 4 / USB4 (40 Gb/s); works with Thunderbolt 3 and USB-C hosts
specs.dual_display_max: 2 × 4K @ 60 Hz (Windows, Intel Mac); 2 × 6K @ 60 Hz on Apple M1 Pro/Max and later
specs.power_delivery_note: 98 W sustained to the host; 230 W power supply included
specs.ports: 3 × Thunderbolt 4 (1 host, 2 downstream), 3 × USB-C 10 Gb/s, 5 × USB-A 10 Gb/s, 1 × DisplayPort 1.4, SD 4.0 UHS-II, microSD 4.0 UHS-II, 2.5 GbE, front audio combo, rear audio in, rear audio out

products.title: Dell WD19S 130W USB-C Dock
products.summary: USB-C business dock with three video outputs and 90 W power delivery to any USB-C PD laptop.

specs.power_delivery_note: 90 W to Dell and non-Dell USB-C PD laptops with the included 130 W adapter
specs.ports: 2 × DisplayPort 1.4, 1 × HDMI 2.0, 1 × USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 with DisplayPort 1.4, 1 × USB-C 3.2 Gen 2, 3 × USB-A 3.2 Gen 1 (1 with PowerShare), Gigabit Ethernet

products.title: Lenovo ThinkPad Universal USB-C Dock (40AY)
products.summary: Universal USB-C dock with dual DisplayPort 1.4 and HDMI 2.0 for mixed laptop fleets.

specs.power_delivery_note: 65 W with the included 90 W adapter; up to 100 W only with the optional 135 W adapter (4X20E50558, sold separately)
specs.ports: 2 × DisplayPort 1.4, 1 × HDMI 2.0, 3 × USB-A 3.1 Gen 2 (1 always-on), 2 × USB-A 2.0, 1 × USB-C 10 Gb/s, Gigabit Ethernet, 3.5 mm audio combo

products.title: Anker 563 USB-C Docking Station (10-in-1)
products.summary: Compact DisplayLink dock with triple-display output and 100 W laptop charging.

specs.host_connection: USB-C (DisplayPort Alt Mode + DisplayLink; driver required for the 2K outputs)
specs.power_delivery_note: Up to 100 W to the host; 180 W power adapter included
specs.ports: 1 × HDMI (4K @ 30 Hz), 1 × HDMI (2K), 1 × DisplayPort (2K), 1 × USB-C 5 Gb/s (30 W), 1 × USB-A 5 Gb/s, 2 × USB-A 2.0, Gigabit Ethernet, 3.5 mm audio

products.title: Plugable UD-ULTC4K Triple 4K Display Dock
products.summary: Triple 4K 60 Hz USB-C dock (DisplayLink + Alt Mode) with 100 W charging.

specs.host_connection: USB-C 10 Gb/s, Thunderbolt or USB4 (DisplayLink driver required)
specs.dual_display_max: 2 × 4K @ 60 Hz (3 × 4K @ 60 Hz with DP 1.4 Alt Mode hosts)
specs.power_delivery_note: Up to 100 W to the host (96 W certified); 135 W power supply included
specs.ports: 3 × video outputs (each HDMI 2.0 or DisplayPort 1.2), 4 × USB-A 5 Gb/s, 1 × USB-C 10 Gb/s (20 W), SD card reader, audio in, audio out, Gigabit Ethernet
